title: What a Ridgecrest RxSecure Account Treats as Already Settled
content:
What a Ridgecrest RxSecure stand-alone Medicare Part D prescription drug plan account treats as already settled, when a settlement figure is worked out, is read from the number of premium payments standing posted on the account and from the standing of the enrollment. The plan treats a history of 3 or more premium payments as a settled payment history.

1. Where the premium payments standing posted on the account are 3 or more and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, every premium payment posted on the account is taken as already settled.
2. Where the premium payments standing posted on the account are fewer than 3 and the enrollment stands in its premium grace period, the premium payments posted on the account in the 6 months up to the handling date are taken as already settled.
3. Where neither holds, the latest premium payment posted on the account is taken as already settled.

| Premium payments posted on the account | Standing of the enrollment | What is taken as already settled |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 or more | in its premium grace period | every premium payment posted on the account |
| fewer than 3 | in its premium grace period | the premium payments posted in the 6 months up to the handling date |
| 3 or more | in force, terminated, or any other footing | the latest premium payment posted on the account |
| fewer than 3 | in force, terminated, or any other footing | the latest premium payment posted on the account |

An account carrying exactly 3 premium payments meets the settled payment history; one carrying 2 does not.

## Worked on a hypothetical account

Take an account carrying 4 premium payments totalling 152.00 USD, of which 2 totalling 76.00 USD fall in the 6 months up to the handling date, the latest of them being 38.00 USD.

- In its premium grace period, with 4 payments posted: 152.00 USD is taken as already settled.
- In its premium grace period, had only 2 payments been posted: 76.00 USD, the total of those inside the 6-month window, would be taken as already settled.
- In force, on the same account: 38.00 USD, the latest payment posted, is taken as already settled.
